description.value:
You gain one of the following options of your choice.

Volley. As an action, you can make a ranged attack against every creature within 10 feet of a point you can see within your weapon's range, provided you have ammunition for each one; roll a separate attack for every target.

Whirlwind Attack. As an action, you can make a melee attack against every creature within 5 feet of you, rolling a separate attack for each target.
